subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a core/plugin API for pre-selection skill-creation authority, or should custom skill creators rely on existing plugin tools, `/learn`, `proposal_content`, and tool policy?
rationale: The current implementation already offers proposal persistence and tool-policy hooks, but choosing a new routing authority affects plugin API shape, config semantics, and skill-write governance.

options.title: Design a narrow authority API
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a small contract that lets custom workflows prepare proposal content while Skill Workshop remains the only write/apply boundary.

options.title: Document current surfaces only
options.body: Treat custom creators as plugin or skill tools that prepare content and call Skill Workshop, with operators using tool policy to influence exposure.

options.title: Move to ClawHub convention
options.body: If maintainers decide no core routing API belongs here, define the workflow packaging convention outside core through ClawHub skills or plugins.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow authority API
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a small contract that lets custom workflows prepare proposal content while Skill Workshop remains the only write/apply boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on `/learn`, Skill Workshop prompt shape, and tool-policy diagnostics makes this the closest current product/API routing owner signal.
